thread:
Emily (AE): Hey team — EDU customer wants a private on‑prem deployment for a 6‑month pilot. They asked if we can reduce the platform fee and only take Standard support (no 24/7). Need guidance: what is the minimum commit or discount we can offer without Deal Desk sign‑off? Also need list of required approvals so I can prep the quote.

Samir (Solutions Eng): Quick notes on the tech side: on‑prem pack means we ship the control plane bits + 2 GPU nodes (NVIDIA A100 equivalent) and a Private CA config. POC scope looks light (10k tokens/day typical), we can set lower resources but still need the platform fee to cover maintenance & deployment automation.

Emily (AE): They said budget is tight (edu lab). Asking for an academic rate if possible.

Raj (Deal Desk): @Emily — academic/education discounts fall under special pricing. We generally allow up to 25% off list on platform fee for verified edu orgs with a minimum 12‑month commit. For <12 months or 6‑month pilots, discount requires director approval and finance signoff. If they want Standard support only and no SLA uplift, that helps.

Alex (Finance): To add: if we drop the platform fee by >20% for a 6‑month deal, unit economics get rough unless they commit to a renewal at a pre‑agreed rate. Options: (a) 15% off for 6 months then revert, (b) 30% off if they sign a 12‑month renewal clause at net new ARR >= $25k.

Samir (Solutions Eng): For POC ops — recommend we include a small onboarding retainer (one‑time $3k) to cover install + validation. Keeps the platform base fee smaller but ensures we cover engineer time. Also ask for a test dataset and network diagram ahead of install.

Marta (Legal): Heads up — even pilots on‑prem require our standard on‑prem Annex: export controls, data handling, and indemnity carveouts. For educational institutions we can use an abbreviated SOW but Legal needs to review any changes to support warranties.

Emily (AE): Can we do: platform fee 15% off, one‑time onboarding $3k, Standard support only, 6‑month pilot, with a renewal option for 12 months at a pre‑agreed rate? If yes, what approvals?

Raj (Deal Desk): That sounds reasonable as a starting ask. Approvals needed: Deal Desk manager for discount >15%, Finance for revenue deferral language if we do the renewal kick, and Legal for SOW deviations. If you include the renewal clause that binds them to 12 months after pilot, that's treated as a commitment and we can stretch to 25% off but only with revenue target >= $25k ARR.

dealdesk-bot: Policy excerpt: "Discount >15% requires Deal Desk manager approval. Any multi‑term or renewal‑triggering clauses must be reviewed by Finance. Academic/edu discounts flagged for verification." (link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/discount-policy)

Alex (Finance): Quick calc: baseline platform fee = $6k/month. 15% off => $5.1k/month. For 6 months that's $30.6k total. With $3k onboarding, total = $33.6k. If we want to get to the 25% band we need to ensure a 12‑month follow‑on at >= $25k ARR.

Samir (Solutions Eng): One more ops caveat — no Standard support means we won't commit to on‑call outside business hours for install issues. If they can't tolerate admin downtime during tests, we should keep Enhanced support.

Marta (Legal): Also need to confirm export control checks for any student data. If PII is expected, add data processing addendum (DPA) signoff before install.

Emily (AE): Action items for me to move the quote: 1) confirm edu status & ask for renewal intent, 2) propose 15% off + $3k onboarding + Standard support for 6 months, 3) include optional renewal clause (12 months) to unlock 25% — mark as contingent on Legal/Finance approval, 4) send skeleton SOW to Legal for review. I'll draft the quote and ping Deal Desk for manager approval if they accept renewal.

Raj (Deal Desk): Sounds good. Ping me the draft pricing grid and the customer's revenue expectation. I'll queue for approval.

Emily (AE): Will do. Draft incoming in ~2 hours. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
